assertions.detail: A sub-agent was spawned and did the work, but nothing bound it to the plugin's packaged agent definition. The parent thread called collaboration.spawn_agent with task_name 'kinglet_capability_reviewer' -- a free-text string the model composed after reading the name out of SKILL.md and AGENTS.md, not a registry lookup -- and a real child thread ran (thread_source 'subagent', depth 1, agent_role null). That child never received kinglet-capability-reviewer.agent.md: it read SKILL.md and AGENTS.md itself, ignored the agent's declared 'tools: Read' by calling apply_patch and exec_command, and wrote a receipt in the AGENTS.md schema (kinglet.client-probe.receipt/v1) rather than the reviewer's own kinglet.client-probe.agent/v1 with its required 'agreement' field.

Discovered by name, called, and the call was cancelled. Under the frozen mcp-call-01 prompt the client emitted an mcp_tool_call item with server 'kinglet-client-probe' and tool 'kinglet_probe_read_marker', with arguments {"project_root": "<project-root>"} -- the correct server, the correct tool name and the correct argument, none of which were in the prompt. The item then completed with status 'failed' and error 'user cancelled MCP tool call', so no result body was returned and no receipt was saved.

A structured JSON receipt was written to disk by the client at the path the probe rules declare. In the agent-delegation-01 run the client used apply_patch to add .kinglet-probe/receipts/agent.json -- the path AGENTS.md reserves for the reviewer -- containing valid JSON with schema kinglet.client-probe.receipt/v1, marker KINGLET_CLIENT_PROBE_PROJECT and unity_version 6000.3.11f1, matching the on-disk marker file and ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt. The post-run listing confirms both that file and .kinglet-probe/receipts/workflow.json on disk with those contents.

Invoked by natural language and produced its defined receipt, both halves. Given the frozen workflow-natural-language-01 prompt, the client opened with 'I'm using the installed kinglet-capability-probe skill because it exactly matches this workflow request', loaded the skill body, ran the executable invocation the skill's Step 2 specifies, and returned exactly 'KINGLET_CLIENT_PROBE_OK 6000.3.11f1' -- the string Step 4 mandates, with no additional prose. .kinglet-probe/receipts/workflow.json was created with the frozen schema, marker and unity_version, and no file outside the skill's declared write was touched.
